scope: Crash, storage, lock, unknown-write, external-edit, network-loss, schema-drift, and SQLite-backup recovery regression

red_evidence.reason: hard-kill recovery remained blocked by a stale writer lease and the database backup API returned no usable snapshot

assertions: a hard-killed child process leaves a durable running checkpoint that reopens after dead-PID lease recovery
a still-live writer lease continues to block a competing writer
simulated object-store failure cannot create dangling database metadata
an unknown remote draft outcome is persisted and repeated submission performs zero additional draft writes
remote human edits remain explicit readback conflicts rather than being overwritten
detector transport loss and response schema drift remain unknown and never become success
SQLite online backup captures one committed point in time and stays readable after the live database changes
backup files carry byte count and SHA-256 and existing targets are never overwritten

review.kind: separate primary-agent review because delegated review is disabled by session policy
